title: Gameplay source inventory, 2026-10-19
method: Every Git-changed file against main, including current owned cast-bar edits. TypeScript named top-level declarations and class methods compared with comments/formatting normalized. Added files can contain extracted old behavior. Nested callbacks and module-level registration bodies are covered by their file diff, not individually named. Signature-only does not establish unchanged behavior of called dependencies. This is a source inventory, not a claim of gameplay parity.
